scope: Outcome-exposed Development benchmark; not Final EXIT, Fresh/OOS, prospective, or live estimate

selectorAndEntry.rankingCohort: All frozen actual Entry fills; NO_ENTRY never receives portfolio cash

exit.identity: R50_B all-row zero-model-exit forced terminal hold; behaviorally equivalent R49_A
exit.actionAt930: Exact endpoint-stamped 15:30 single-price auction; no 15:25 substitute
exit.buyCost: Frozen effective Entry price embeds buy-side 5bps; never double-charge
exit.r37SelectGuard: Never call SELECT-only R37 portfolio_scorecard or evaluator_bucket_attribution for this benchmark

rank.producer: R35 Frozen Selector origin projection; no new fit or score
rank.knownAt: origin.decisionTimestamp <= frozen Entry event; explicit assertion each candidate
rank.missingOrInvalid: Fail closed, no substitute rank or priority

allocation.targetJpy: fresh current equity after confirmed EXIT / maximum concurrent position count
allocation.quantity: largest 100-share lot with entry effective price * quantity <= min(targetJpy, actual available cash)
allocation.positions: same-symbol duplicate blocked; maximum concurrent symbol count is the capacity
allocation.reject: capacity / duplicate symbol / insufficient 100-share lot / missing fresh mark, record exactly once; no reconsideration

eventOrder: fresh known-NOW mark of still-open holdings
clockAndMarks.entryEvent: frozen effective Entry minute and price, no forward search
clockAndMarks.heldPositionMark: only exact completed scheduled 1m bar ending at event NOW, raw CLOSE; knownAt <= NOW; at terminal exact auction price
clockAndMarks.newEntryMark: exact Entry-minute raw OPEN at NOW when available, never same-minute HIGH/CLOSE; otherwise equity unknown
clockAndMarks.missingMark: equity null and new sizing unresolved; never forward fill, cost mark, or zero-PnL imputation
clockAndMarks.afterUnresolvedTerminal: continue carrying locked cash and position; future event sizing blocked whenever any held position has no exact NOW mark; no fictional liquidation
clockAndMarks.lunch: 11:30 to 12:30 has no continuous bar; exact completed-bar stamp only
clockAndMarks.interval: event-time point snapshots; duration-weighted utilization only across intervals with both endpoints completely priced; report covered/total duration

enrichment.evaluationStage: after protocol Freeze and before portfolio scorecard inspection
enrichment.topNMeaning: Within each simultaneous exact Entry-time candidate batch, take first N frozen-rank items; independent of cash/capacity; do not rank across future intraday candidates
enrichment.denominator: all frozen filled Entry candidates for each arm; report candidate counts and batch counts
enrichment.primaryEvaluator: POST_ENTRY_UPSIDE_GE5 = entryToPostEntryHighPct >= 5 from frozen benchmark metrics, evaluator only
enrichment.reach: distinct candidate opportunities in topN meeting bucket divided by all bucket opportunities in that arm
enrichment.baselineRate: bucket count / all filled Entry candidates in arm
enrichment.missingUpside: evaluator null with explicit count, no selection-side filtering
enrichment.sessionStability: per-session selected counts, hit rates and reach, including zero-hit sessions
enrichment.concentration: symbol and session share by selected candidate count

portfolioScorecard.finalEquityAndReturn: null if any held position has no exact final mark or final unresolved EXIT; never compute return from cash alone
portfolioScorecard.maxDrawdown: null as a full-period statistic unless entire defined timeline is completely marked; otherwise provide explicitly partial covered-only drawdown
portfolioScorecard.attribution: after all capital decisions, evaluator-only on funded vs available POST_ENTRY_UPSIDE_GE5 and CANONICAL_L2H_GE5, with capital amounts/net/capture
portfolioScorecard.paired: join IM and R1 by opportunity after independent cash replays; report common candidate/funded counts, price/time/rank/allocation/terminal net/lock
portfolioScorecard.zeroPassBehavior: No EXIT SELECT or Entry re-selection implied by benchmark score

reproducibility: identical input pins + protocol + source => two byte-identical canonical output runs, no performance-tuned edit
